content.question: Which statement about LIME and SHAP is correct?
options: LIME is based on Shapley values, while SHAP fits a linear surrogate model.
LIME explains individual predictions by approximating the model locally with a simpler surrogate model, while SHAP distributes feature importance fairly across predictions using Shapley values.
Both techniques require retraining the neural network from scratch.
SHAP perturbs only the input images, while LIME perturbs only the output labels.
content.answer: LIME explains individual predictions by approximating the model locally with a simpler surrogate model, while SHAP distributes feature importance fairly across predictions using Shapley values.
